title: Alexander says MJ-12 was continuity of government

tellings.quote: Colonel John B. Alexander said that the Majestic 12 was specifically a continuity of government program,
MJ12, but John talked about it in an interview. Uh, and he said, "Yeah, there was, but it it didn't have anything to do with UFOs."
tellings.difference: Grant Cameron relays it from an interview and adds that it had nothing to do with UFOs.
tellings.link_reason: Both are John Alexander's statement that MJ-12 was real but was a continuity-of-government program.

as_told.title: John Alexander: MJ12 was real but about continuity of government

plain: Majestic 12, a secret group said in UFO lore to have managed the government's UFO secrets, was really a plan to keep the government running in a catastrophe: that is what John B. Alexander, a retired Army colonel, is said to have stated. A UFO commentator who goes by UAPGerb relays that Alexander called it "specifically a continuity of government program." The researcher Grant Cameron says he heard Alexander say in an interview, "Yeah, there was, but it didn't have anything to do with UFOs." If so, the famous group existed but had nothing to do with flying saucers.
